evidence.title: How to Create a "Pre-Qualification PDF" That Gets You Shortlisted (Template Inside) | Stonehenge Digital KE

name: How to Create a "Pre-Qualification PDF" That Gets You Shortlisted
summary: Section-by-section tutorial for building a tender-ready pre-qualification PDF, or capability statement, for Kenyan SMEs.
description: Blog tutorial that walks a business through assembling a pre-qualification PDF in seven sections: cover page, company profile, capacity statement, past performance with a sample project table, key personnel, compliance and credentials, and contact and references. Adds layout advice (free templates, two fonts, under 10 pages, export as PDF) and usage tips such as hosting it for download, attaching it to tenders and updating it quarterly.
